region.finding: Fresh independent all-clip source/battle review confirms the exposed tongue folds toward the chest during hit reaction and defeat while the skull stays intact. Tongue vertices retain neck/chest influences. Candidate requires full geometry, body, production and repeated visual review.

Fresh independent all-clip source/battle review confirms the lower jaw compresses in alternate idle and hit reactions, and folds toward the scarf in defeat. Independent lower-face vertices retain neck/chest weights. Separate candidate requires full geometry, body, production and repeated visual review.
Horn and fore-head shell deform independently during strike/cast. All 13 original body and head clips inspected; dense world edge ratios reach 3.59.

Beak/skull shape compresses under blended head/neck weights during strike. All 13 original body and head clips inspected; dense world shape compression confirmed. Separate forward beak region includes the complete tip while preserving neck articulation.

union.finding: All original clips reviewed; muzzle shear confirmed. Fade head binding smoothly before the hand flame, preserving all excluded accessory vertices and avoiding the abrupt weight boundary found in candidate v3. Current candidate needs complete reinspection.

region.finding: Preserve the old head binding and add the complete front muzzle, chin and both whiskers. The old outer-x exclusions stay confined to the old region; the front-only new region excludes the rear flame by depth. Independent left/right whisker probes separately check the full shafts and tips.
